requirements.text: Allow coordinators to export reservation reports.
requirements.quote: Coordinators must be allowed to export reservation reports too.
requirements.speaker: Nora
requirements.note: The baseline restricts export to administrators. Board approval is explicitly pending.

requirements.text: Export UTF-8 CSV using the active report filters.
requirements.quote: Keep the export as UTF-8 CSV using the active filters.
requirements.speaker: Nora
requirements.note: PDF was withdrawn; scheduled report email was explicitly excluded from this request.

requirements.text: Show a month-by-month reservation count grouped by reservation start month.
requirements.quote: Add a month-by-month reservation count to the report, grouped by reservation start month.
requirements.speaker: Nora
requirements.note: The baseline has a filter-matched overall count, not a monthly breakdown.

requirements.speaker: Owen
requirements.note: No report size or measurable response-time target is agreed.

expected_stories.title: Show monthly reservation counts
expected_stories.i_want: see reservation counts grouped by start month
expected_stories.so_that: I can report monthly usage without manual calculation
acceptance_criteria: Given a report interval spanning multiple months, when the report is opened, then it shows one count for each reservation start month in that interval.
Given active report filters, when monthly counts are shown, then only matching reservations contribute to the counts.

questions: Does the board approve coordinator export access?
What report size and maximum response time define instant export?
